title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_pg_secret_expired}
description: Phase 8 §8.13.6 — emitted when the backup-role PG password age exceeds cfg.maint_backup_pg_secret_max_age_days. The agent refuses to start until the password is rotated. Companion maint.event.v1 to sec.alert.v1{kind=backup_pg_secret_expired}. Notification only.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

secret_age_days.description: Current age of the backup-role PG password in days.

secret_name.description: Identifier for the secret (e.g. env-var name or secret-manager path, redacted).
